svg.title: RuneLite Hitch Profiler side panel guide
svg.desc: The profiler side panel, annotated with callouts for capture status, session controls, live metrics, graph, filters, comparison, event details and local notes. The private path in the source screenshot is replaced with generic status text.
svg.text: A quick guide to the live capture, event history and session tools.

g.text: CAPTURE STATUS
Shows whether capture is active, paused, or waiting
for RuneLite frames.
LIVE METRICS
Hitch totals, severe spikes, peak gap and map-load
intervals at a glance.
HITCH TREND
The graph gives recent frame timing context;
red marks severe gaps.
EVENT HISTORY
Filter the list, select an event for details, and
drag the divider to resize the history area.
SESSION CONTROLS
Pause a run or start a new session. The Compare
tab keeps the previous summary close.
SAVED + EVENT CONTEXT
Saved lists earlier events. Severe entries may include
stack samples, nearby clues and a map location.
NOTES + LOCAL RECORD
Add route or renderer notes and copy the session
summary. Event files stay on this device; the
personal path is hidden in this public-facing image.

svg.text: LIVE CAPTURE · SESSION COMPARISON · LOCAL JSONL + HTML HISTORY
